settings.tab_content: Harvested from fields verified to have zero synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, or chemical sewage sludge applied for a minimum of three years.
Grown using traditional open-pollinated seed varieties. We strictly prohibit the use of genetically modified organisms (GMOs) in our farming chain.
Maintained at a constant 4°C from harvest point to delivery box, preserving structural crispness, natural enzymes, and high vitamin levels.
Our farmers employ natural compost layering, multi-crop rotation patterns, and cover cropping to maintain organic soil biology indexes.
